body:
Amendment A1 posted on STORY-1706: re-exec of verbatim ORIG_ARGS starts a NEW run (--label) and overwrites the handoff with the initial prompt.
Proposal: record orig_arg= (verbatim) + arg= = a relay-built resume argv (--run <id> --use-existing, no prompt/label/start-session/detach); the tick still execs only arg= + --max-sessions (C1).
Need a yes/no; continuing the independent PR B parts meanwhile.
subject: STORY-1706 amendment A1 needs ruling (resume argv)
